text.en:
Purpose

This Decree establishes the principles and regulations related to the management,
utilization and monitoring of the Emergency Relief Fund to ensure that such fund operates
properly, efficiently and effectively, with the aim of providing funding for emergency
humanitarian assistance to victims in an urgent and timely manner.

Emergency Relief Fund
The Emergency Relief Fund, abbreviated as “ກທຊສ” and denoted in English as
"Emergency Relief Fund" "ERF," is a fund established to accumulate and mobilize
funding from various sources, both domestic and international, with the aim of ensuring
a sufficient and sustainable budget to provide emergency humanitarian assistance to
victims affected in terms of [their] physical, lives, psychological, and property aspects
due to natural or man-made disasters in an urgent, timely, efficient and effective manner.

Terminology
   The terms used in this Decree contain the following meanings:
1. Victim refers to an individual who is affected or incurred damage in terms of [their]
physical, lives, psychological and property aspects due to natural or man-made disaster;
2. Emergency assistance refers to the response and action taken to address the
initial impacts of disaster through emergency rescue and emergency relief;
3. Emergency rescue refers to the deployment of rapid assistance to affected
areas to save, assist and provide physical and psychological first aid to victims of natural
or man-made disaster; mainly road, air, water accidents, flood, fire, storm, landslide,
building collapse, earthquake [and] epidemics;
4. Emergency relief refers to the deployment to affected areas to provide initial
relief assistance through distribution of essential non-food items and food items, as well
as psychological alleviation to victims of natural or man-made disasters in an urgent
manner.

Scope of Application
   This Decree applies to domestic and foreign individuals, entities [and] organizations,
both the public and private sectors, operating and engaging with ERF in Lao PDR.

Part 2
Revenue Sources and Utilization of Emergency Relief Fund

Opening Deposit Account for Emergency Relief Fund

ERF shall have an accounting system in compliance with the Law on Accounting. It
can open a deposit account at the National Treasury and/or at a secure and credible
commercial bank in Lao PDR, as agreed by the financial sector. All revenue sources of ERF
shall be transferred into such deposit account.

Disbursement of Emergency Relief Fund
 Disbursement of funding from the deposit account at the National Treasury or
commercial banks shall align with the programs, projects and activities considered and
approved by the Board of Directors of ERF, and [supported by] a plan developed correctly
in accordance with the Government accounting and relevant regulations.

Request for Utilization of Emergency Relief Fund
Once an emergency event occurs, the Secretariat of ERF can approve the use of ERF for
the [Lao Red Cross] Office, the Provincial, Capital Red Cross Branch or the District,
Municipality, City Red Cross Office, where the emergency event took place, to deploy for data
collection, damage assessment and consolidate the needs for initial assistance, in order to [make
the] request to the Secretariat of ERF within twenty-four hours starting from the day of
deployment for data collection.
The Secretariat of ERF shall develop the plan for initial assistance within twenty-four
hours starting from the day when the data is received, in order to propose to the Board of
Directors of ERF at its level for consideration.
Details on the process and procedure for the utilization of ERF are established in a
separate regulation.

Approval for utilization of Emergency Relief Fund
The Board of Directors of ERF at each level is [the body that] approves the
utilization of ERF within twenty-four hours starting from the day when the action plan
is received, if the request for utilization of ERF is considered consistent with the criteria
and objectives as established in this Decree.
In the case where district or provincial level ERF has insufficient funding for
emergency assistance during the disaster, the Board of Directors of ERF at such level
shall request to the Board of Directors of ERF at the provincial or central level for
consideration of approval.

Withdrawal from the Emergency Relief Fund
Withdrawal from the deposit account of ERF requires two signatures of the
signatories authorized by the Board of Directors of ERF and it must lie within the approved
activity plan only.
Withdrawal from the deposit account shall not exceed the total revenue of ERF in
each fiscal year. The funding of ERF cannot be withdrawn entirely and must retain at least
ten percent (10%) of the amount in the deposit account of ERF.

Part 3
Management of Emergency Relief Fund

Organization structure of the Emergency Relief Fund
The organization structure of ERF at each level consists of the followings:
1. Board of Directors of ERF;
2. Secretariat of ERF.

Board of Directors of the Emergency Relief Fund
The Board of Directors of ERF is a non-standing body responsible for the operation
of ERF. The Board of Directors of ERF consists of the Chair, Vice-Chair and a number of
members from the relevant parties.
The Board of Directors of ERF at the central level is appointed by the Prime Minister
as per the recommendation of the President of Lao Red Cross. The Board of Directors of
ERF at the provincial level is appointed by the Provincial, Capital Governor as per the
recommendation of the Head of Provincial, Capital Red Cross Branch. The Board of
Directors at the district level is appointed by the District, Municipality, City Governor as per
the recommendation of the Head of District, Municipality, City Red Cross Branch.
The term of office for the Board of Directors of ERF at each level is five years and
the term can be further extended.

Emergency Relief Fund Board of Directors Meeting
The Board of Directors of ERF at each level [shall] convene its ordinary meeting at
least once per year. In the case of necessity or urgency, an extra-ordinary meeting can be
convened any time, as called by the Chair of the Board of Directors of ERF or at the proposal
of at least one-third of the total members of the Board of Directors. The meeting can
commence once at least two-third of the total members of the Board of Directors of ERF
are present.
The resolutions of the ERF Board of Directors Meeting are decided by majority
votes; in the case of equal votes, the recommendation of the Chair shall be taken as the final
verdict, but the statement of the minority votes shall be recorded for information.
In the case where the Chair of the Board of Directors is not presence or unavailable,
the authorized Vice-Chair shall perform such duty in [his/her] place.

Secretariat of Emergency Relief Fund
The Secretariat of the Emergency Relief Fund is an established body that functions
on a permanent basis to support the Board of Directors of ERF in the management of ERF.
[For] the Secretariat of ERF at the central level, the Fundraising and Disaster
Management Office of the Lao Red Cross is designated as the place of operation for the
management of ERF, which shall consists of the Director, one to two Deputy Director(s)
and a number of assistant staffs appointed or discharged by the Board of Directors of ERF
and their term of office is equal to that of the Board of Directors of ERF.
For the Secretariat of the Board of Directors of ERF at the provincial and district
level, the Board of Directors of ERF at such level shall be the one to appoint the members.

Auditing
The accounts of ERF at each level shall be audited every year by the State Audit
Organization. The audit findings shall be verified by the Board of Directors of ERF and
reported to the Lao Red Cross at its level, as well as shared with the general public for the
purpose of transparency on the utilization of funding from ERF.
In the case where a violation of laws and regulations is identified, offenders will face
the measures stipulated in the laws according to each case.

Inspection
Inspection of ERF is an evaluation of the utilization of ERF to ensure transparency,
efficiency, effectiveness, and compliance with the laws and regulations.
The inspection of ERF at each level shall encompass the main contents as following:
1. Inspection on the implementation of plans, programs, and projects related to ERF;
2. Sources of revenue [and] implementation of the expenditure plans of ERF;
3. Inspection on the operation of the Secretariat of ERF and implementation of
various policies.

Types of Inspection
The inspection of ERF consists of the following types:
1. Regular inspection is a planned inspection conducted on a regular basis, following
a precisely defined timeframe;
2. Inspection with advance notification is an unplanned inspection undertaken when
deemed necessary, with prior notice extended to the subject of inspection.
3. Surprise inspection is an urgent inspection without prior notice extended to the
subject of inspection.
When conducting the inspection, the inspection officials shall strictly comply with
the laws and regulations.

Reporting
The Secretariat of ERF at each level shall report on the management and utilization
of ERF, including the quarterly, biannual and annual revenues-expenditures to the Board of
Directors at its level for endorsement and reporting to its higher-level authorities and other
relevant parties.

Part 5
Final Provision

Stamp
ERF has its own stamp to serve the operation of official business.

Implementation
Lao Red Cross shall take the initiative to effectively execute and implement this
Decree.
Ministries, state ministry-equivalent agencies, local administrative authorities and
relevant parties shall acknowledge and strictly implement this Decree.

Effective Date
This Decree is effective starting on 23 August 2023.

On behalf of the Government of Lao PDR


     Prime Minister


[Signed and Stamped]

Sonexay SIPHADONE
